literalCallbackAudit.name: 1867实际用攻当次40%次次累加，首二次真实红伤PP与倍率1.4/1.8
literalCallbackAudit.callbackText: test('1867实际用攻当次40%次次累加，首二次真实红伤PP与倍率1.4/1.8',()=>{const s=make(),mods=[];for(let n=1;n<=2;n++){const before=s.fighters[1].hp;turn(s,10001,20456,{observe(ev,c){if(ev==='beforeDamage'&&c.a.side===0)mods.push(c.modifier);}});assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.tiger1867.layers,n);assert.ok(s.fighters[1].hp<before);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(10001)],35-n);assert.ok(red(s)>0);}assert.equal(mods[0],1.4);assert.equal(mods[1],1.8);})

literalCallbackAudit.name: 1867属性与被控未用不叠层，属性耗PP而睡眠保PP
literalCallbackAudit.callbackText: test('1867属性与被控未用不叠层，属性耗PP而睡眠保PP',()=>{const s=turn(make(),20456,20456,{roll:.5});assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.tiger1867.layers,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(20456)],9);s.fighters[0].ailments['睡眠']=99;turn(s,10001,20456,{roll:.5});assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.tiger1867.layers,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(10001)],35);})

literalCallbackAudit.name: 1867未受红时50%实际边界小于半触焚烬，等于半授次轮先制用攻烧伤
literalCallbackAudit.callbackText: test('1867未受红时50%实际边界小于半触焚烬，等于半授次轮先制用攻烧伤',()=>{const yes=turn(make(),20456,20456,{roll:.499999}),no=turn(make(),20456,20456,{roll:.5});assert.ok(yes.fighters[1].ailments['焚烬']>=2);assert.equal(no.fighters[1].ailments['焚烬'],undefined);assert.equal(no.fighters[0].soulState.tiger1867.priorityRound,2);turn(no,10001,20456);assert.equal(no.fighters[0].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,1);assert.ok(no.fighters[1].ailments['烧伤']>=2);assert.equal(no.fighters[0].pp[key(10001)],34);assert.ok(red(no)>0);})

literalCallbackAudit.name: 1867焚烬被次数免异阻断仍未触发补偿，真实消耗1次免异
literalCallbackAudit.callbackText: test('1867焚烬被次数免异阻断仍未触发补偿，真实消耗1次免异',()=>{const s=make();s.fighters[1].counts.immune=1;turn(s,20456,20456,{roll:0});assert.equal(s.fighters[1].counts.immune,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].ailments['焚烬'],undefined);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.tiger1867.priorityRound,2);})

literalCallbackAudit.name: 1867敌免攻完整红0仍触发战阶，而保1正完整红实际HP0不触发
literalCallbackAudit.callbackText: test('1867敌免攻完整红0仍触发战阶，而保1正完整红实际HP0不触发',()=>{const zero=make();timer(zero,1,'攻击伤害免疫');turn(zero,10001,20456,{roll:0});assert.equal(red(zero),0);assert.ok(zero.fighters[1].ailments['焚烬']>=2);const keep=make();keep.fighters[1].hp=1;timer(keep,1,'致命保留',{hp:1});turn(keep,10001,20456,{roll:0});assert.ok(red(keep)>0);assert.equal(keep.fighters[1].hp,1);assert.equal(keep.fighters[1].ailments['焚烬'],undefined);assert.equal(keep.fighters[0].soulState.tiger1867.rolls,undefined);})

literalCallbackAudit.name: 1867实际MISS仍已用攻叠40并耗PP，控制未用已另测
literalCallbackAudit.callbackText: test('1867实际MISS仍已用攻叠40并耗PP，控制未用已另测',()=>{const s=make({hit:false});timer(s,0,'攻击必失');turn(s,10001,20456,{roll:.5});assert.equal(red(s),0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(10001)],34);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.tiger1867.layers,1);})

literalCallbackAudit.name: 1867实际整招无效仍已用攻叠40并耗PP，非红固定不视为受到攻击伤害
literalCallbackAudit.callbackText: test('1867实际整招无效仍已用攻叠40并耗PP，非红固定不视为受到攻击伤害',()=>{const s=make();timer(s,0,'attackBlock');turn(s,10001,20456,{roll:.5});assert.equal(red(s),0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(10001)],34);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.tiger1867.layers,1);const t=make();const old=H.E.SOULS;H.E.SOULS={...old,run(ev,c){old.run(ev,c);if(ev==='roundStart'&&c.a.side===0)c.hurt(c.t,100,'明确非红研究','fixed');}};try{turn(t,20456,20456,{roll:0});}finally{H.E.SOULS=old;}assert.ok(t.fighters[1].ailments['焚烬']>=2);assert.ok(t.fighters[1].hp<=8900);})

literalCallbackAudit.name: 1867真实三次攻到120%不超层，仅首次达顶概率时点001明确模型有50/60差
literalCallbackAudit.callbackText: test('1867真实三次攻到120%不超层，仅首次达顶概率时点001明确模型有50/60差',()=>{const s=make();for(let n=0;n<3;n++)turn(s);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.tiger1867.layers,3);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(10001)],32);assert.throws(()=>turn(structuredClone(s),20456,20456,{roll:.55}),/Q-N50-4663-001/);for(const mode of['arrival','subsequent']){const x=structuredClone(s);x.fighters[0].soulState.qualified1867CapProbability=mode;turn(x,20456,20456,{roll:.55});assert.equal(x.fighters[0].soulState.tiger1867.rolls.at(-1).probability,mode==='arrival'?.6:.5);assert.equal((x.fighters[1].ailments['焚烬']??0)>=x.round-1,mode==='arrival');}})

literalCallbackAudit.name: 1867已达顶继续实际用攻提高概率封顶100，攻击增伤仍120且不无限叠
literalCallbackAudit.callbackText: test('1867已达顶继续实际用攻提高概率封顶100，攻击增伤仍120且不无限叠',()=>{const s=make({policies:{qualified1867CapProbability:'subsequent'}});for(let n=0;n<9;n++)turn(s);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.tiger1867.layers,3);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.tiger1867.postCapUses,6);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(10001)],26);turn(s,20456,20456,{roll:.999999});assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.tiger1867.rolls.at(-1).probability,1);assert.ok(s.fighters[1].ailments['焚烬']>=s.round-1);})

literalCallbackAudit.name: 1867补偿下轮结束后的用攻烧伤002自然保护，两明确模型改变真实异常和HP
literalCallbackAudit.callbackText: test('1867补偿下轮结束后的用攻烧伤002自然保护，两明确模型改变真实异常和HP',()=>{const s=turn(make(),20456,20456,{roll:.5});turn(s);s.fighters[1].ailments={};assert.throws(()=>turn(structuredClone(s)),/Q-N50-4663-002/);for(const mode of['next-round','persistent']){const x=structuredClone(s);x.fighters[0].soulState.qualified1867BurnDuration=mode;turn(x);assert.equal((x.fighters[1].ailments['烧伤']??0)>=x.round-1,mode==='persistent');assert.equal(x.fighters[0].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,0);assert.equal(x.fighters[0].pp[key(10001)],33);assert.ok(x.fighters[1].hp<s.fighters[1].hp);}})

literalCallbackAudit.name: 1867真实10646多段只算一次实际使用并各段红伤保持首层40%
literalCallbackAudit.callbackText: test('1867真实10646多段只算一次实际使用并各段红伤保持首层40%',()=>{const s=make({nativeMove:10646,loadout:[10646,20456,10001,10007,37475]}),mods=[];turn(s,10646,20456,{observe(ev,c){if(ev==='beforeDamage'&&c.a.side===0)mods.push(c.modifier);}});assert.ok(mods.length>=2);assert.ok(mods.every(x=>x===1.4));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.tiger1867.layers,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.tiger1867.uses.length,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(10646)],29);assert.ok(red(s)>0);})

literalCallbackAudit.name: 4663完整22原招加真实魂印首用叠层、当次真实PP及攻击红伤而属性不叠
literalCallbackAudit.callbackText: test('4663完整22原招加真实魂印首用叠层、当次真实PP及攻击红伤而属性不叠',()=>{for(const m of H.source.moves){const s=make({moveId:m.id,index:null},{soul:true,policies:{qualified597First4663:'next-use'}});turn(s);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.tiger1867.layers,m.kind==='status'?0:1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],m.id===37473?m.pp:m.pp-1);if(m.kind!=='status')assert.ok(sum(s)>0);}})

literalCallbackAudit.name: 4663基础10001 撞击真实HP/PP/控制/零PP/末次PP
literalCallbackAudit.callbackText: test("4663基础10001 撞击真实HP/PP/控制/零PP/末次PP",()=>{const z=turn(make({moveId:10001,index:-1}));assert.equal(z.fighters[0].pp[key(10001)],34);assert.equal(sum(z)>0,true);const b=make({moveId:10001,index:-1});b.fighters[0].ailments['疲惫']=3;turn(b);assert.equal(b.fighters[0].pp[key(10001)],35);const p=make({moveId:10001,index:-1});p.fighters[0].pp[key(10001)]=0;assert.throws(()=>turn(p),/PP|技能/);p.fighters[0].pp[key(10001)]=1;turn(p);assert.equal(p.fighters[0].pp[key(10001)],0);})

literalCallbackAudit.name: 4663完整22真实原招保留43实例成功、控制未用、整招无效与真实必中/MISS矩阵
literalCallbackAudit.callbackText: test('4663完整22真实原招保留43实例成功、控制未用、整招无效与真实必中/MISS矩阵',()=>{for(const m of H.source.moves){const policies={qualified597First4663:'next-use'},s=make({moveId:m.id,index:null},{policies});turn(s);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],m.id===37473?m.pp:m.pp-1);if(m.kind!=='status')assert.ok(sum(s)>0);const ctrl=make({moveId:m.id,index:null},{policies});ctrl.fighters[0].ailments['疲惫']=3;turn(ctrl);assert.equal(ctrl.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],m.pp);assert.equal(sum(ctrl),0);const invalid=make({moveId:m.id,index:null},{policies});timer(invalid,0,m.kind==='status'?'statusBlock':'attackBlock');turn(invalid);assert.equal(invalid.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],m.pp-1);assert.equal(sum(invalid),0);const miss=make({moveId:m.id,index:null},{policies,hit:false});timer(miss,0,m.kind==='status'?'属性必失':'攻击必失');turn(miss);if(!m.alwaysHit){assert.equal(miss.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],m.pp-1);assert.equal(sum(miss),0);}else if(m.kind!=='status')assert.ok(sum(miss)>0);}})

literalCallbackAudit.name: 4663基础20456 火焰壁垒真实HP/PP/控制/零PP/末次PP
literalCallbackAudit.callbackText: test("4663基础20456 火焰壁垒真实HP/PP/控制/零PP/末次PP",()=>{const z=turn(make({moveId:20456,index:-1}));assert.equal(z.fighters[0].pp[key(20456)],9);assert.equal(sum(z)>0,false);const b=make({moveId:20456,index:-1});b.fighters[0].ailments['疲惫']=3;turn(b);assert.equal(b.fighters[0].pp[key(20456)],10);const p=make({moveId:20456,index:-1});p.fighters[0].pp[key(20456)]=0;assert.throws(()=>turn(p),/PP|技能/);p.fighters[0].pp[key(20456)]=1;turn(p);assert.equal(p.fighters[0].pp[key(20456)],0);})

literalCallbackAudit.name: 4663/44真实特殊红减半五回合，物理不减及到期复原
literalCallbackAudit.callbackText: test('4663/44真实特殊红减半五回合，物理不减及到期复原',()=>{const s=make(e(44));enemyMove(s,10007);turn(s,20456,10007);const dmg=s.fighters[0].stats.maxHp-s.fighters[0].hp;const base=make(e(44),{omit:true});enemyMove(base,10007);turn(base,20456,10007);assert.ok(dmg>0&&dmg<=((9000-base.fighters[0].hp)/2)+1);const phy=make(e(44));turn(phy,20456,10001);const raw=make(e(44),{omit:true});turn(raw,20456,10001);assert.equal(phy.fighters[0].hp,raw.fighters[0].hp);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].effects['分类攻击减伤'].end,5);s.round=6;const expiredBaseline=structuredClone(s);delete expiredBaseline.fighters[0].effects['分类攻击减伤'];turn(s,10001,10007);turn(expiredBaseline,10001,10007);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,expiredBaseline.fighters[0].hp);})

literalCallbackAudit.name: 4663基础10007 火花真实HP/PP/控制/零PP/末次PP
literalCallbackAudit.callbackText: test("4663基础10007 火花真实HP/PP/控制/零PP/末次PP",()=>{const z=turn(make({moveId:10007,index:-1}));assert.equal(z.fighters[0].pp[key(10007)],24);assert.equal(sum(z)>0,true);const b=make({moveId:10007,index:-1});b.fighters[0].ailments['疲惫']=3;turn(b);assert.equal(b.fighters[0].pp[key(10007)],25);const p=make({moveId:10007,index:-1});p.fighters[0].pp[key(10007)]=0;assert.throws(()=>turn(p),/PP|技能/);p.fighters[0].pp[key(10007)]=1;turn(p);assert.equal(p.fighters[0].pp[key(10007)],0);})

literalCallbackAudit.name: 4663/12三概率实例真实烧伤成功失败与免异常消费
literalCallbackAudit.callbackText: test('4663/12三概率实例真实烧伤成功失败与免异常消费',()=>{for(const x of pick(12)){let ok=false,no=false;for(let seed=0;seed<50&&(!ok||!no);seed++){const s=make(x,{seed});turn(s);if(s.fighters[1].ailments['烧伤'])ok=true;else no=true;assert.ok(sum(s)>0);}assert.ok(ok&&no);const immune=make(x);timer(immune,1,'免异常');turn(immune);assert.equal(immune.fighters[1].ailments['烧伤'],undefined);}})

literalCallbackAudit.name: 4663基础10049 火焰拳真实HP/PP/控制/零PP/末次PP
literalCallbackAudit.callbackText: test("4663基础10049 火焰拳真实HP/PP/控制/零PP/末次PP",()=>{const z=turn(make({moveId:10049,index:-1}));assert.equal(z.fighters[0].pp[key(10049)],14);assert.equal(sum(z)>0,true);const b=make({moveId:10049,index:-1});b.fighters[0].ailments['疲惫']=3;turn(b);assert.equal(b.fighters[0].pp[key(10049)],15);const p=make({moveId:10049,index:-1});p.fighters[0].pp[key(10049)]=0;assert.throws(()=>turn(p),/PP|技能/);p.fighters[0].pp[key(10049)]=1;turn(p);assert.equal(p.fighters[0].pp[key(10049)],0);})

literalCallbackAudit.name: 4663基础10646 连刃真实HP/PP/控制/零PP/末次PP
literalCallbackAudit.callbackText: test("4663基础10646 连刃真实HP/PP/控制/零PP/末次PP",()=>{const z=turn(make({moveId:10646,index:-1}));assert.equal(z.fighters[0].pp[key(10646)],29);assert.equal(sum(z)>0,true);const b=make({moveId:10646,index:-1});b.fighters[0].ailments['疲惫']=3;turn(b);assert.equal(b.fighters[0].pp[key(10646)],30);const p=make({moveId:10646,index:-1});p.fighters[0].pp[key(10646)]=0;assert.throws(()=>turn(p),/PP|技能/);p.fighters[0].pp[key(10646)]=1;turn(p);assert.equal(p.fighters[0].pp[key(10646)],0);})

literalCallbackAudit.name: 4663/31真实10646两或三段每段HP并只消费一次PP
literalCallbackAudit.callbackText: test('4663/31真实10646两或三段每段HP并只消费一次PP',()=>{const counts=new Set();for(let seed=0;seed<20;seed++){const s=make(e(31),{seed});turn(s);const ds=s.damageEvents.filter(x=>x.round===1&&x.type==='attack'&&x.targetSide===1);counts.add(ds.length);assert.ok(ds.every(x=>x.settledDamage>0));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(10646)],29);}assert.deepEqual([...counts].sort(),[2,3]);})

literalCallbackAudit.name: 4663基础31206 怒意刀斩真实HP/PP/控制/零PP/末次PP

literalCallbackAudit.name: 4663/1019真实299、300、301红伤边界，仅301封两轮属性并实际无效耗PP
literalCallbackAudit.callbackText: test('4663/1019真实299、300、301红伤边界，仅301封两轮属性并实际无效耗PP',()=>{for(const n of [299,300,301]){const s=boundaryAttack(e(1019),n);assert.equal(!!s.fighters[1].effects.statusBlock,n>300);if(n>300){assert.equal(s.fighters[1].effects.statusBlock.end,2);const before=s.fighters[1].pp[key(20456)];turn(s,10001,20456);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].pp[key(20456)],before-1);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].effects['分类攻击减伤'],undefined);}}})

literalCallbackAudit.name: 4663/1120真实299得300盾，300及301不授盾，已有盾精确保护
literalCallbackAudit.callbackText: test('4663/1120真实299得300盾，300及301不授盾，已有盾精确保护',()=>{for(const n of [299,300,301]){const s=boundaryAttack(e(1120),n);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].suitState.shield,n<300?300:0);}const s=make(e(1120));s.fighters[0].suitState.shield=1;assert.throws(()=>turn(s),/Q-N50-4600-005/);const real=turn(make(e(1120)));assert.equal(real.fighters[0].suitState.shield,300);const hp=real.fighters[0].hp;turn(real,10001,10001);assert.equal(real.fighters[0].hp,hp);assert.ok(real.fighters[0].suitState.shield<300);})

literalCallbackAudit.name: 4663/1120真实完整0伤阈值自然保护，两个明确模型只差300护盾
literalCallbackAudit.callbackText: test('4663/1120真实完整0伤阈值自然保护，两个明确模型只差300护盾',()=>{const s=make(e(1120));s.fighters[1].suitState.shield=9999;assert.throws(()=>turn(s),/Q-N50-4665-001/);for(const mode of ['trigger','skip']){const x=make(e(1120),{policies:{qualified1120Zero4663:mode}});x.fighters[1].suitState.shield=9999;turn(x);assert.equal(sum(x),0);assert.equal(x.fighters[1].hp,9000);assert.equal(x.fighters[0].suitState.shield,mode==='trigger'?300:0);assert.equal(x.fighters[0].pp[key(37475)],4);}})

literalCallbackAudit.name: 4663/1320真实敌攻击MISS回末吸1/3，命中不吸、免百分仍理论回复与禁疗
literalCallbackAudit.callbackText: test('4663/1320真实敌攻击MISS回末吸1/3，命中不吸、免百分仍理论回复与禁疗',()=>{const x=e(1320),s=make(x,{hp:1000});timer(s,1,'攻击必失');turn(s,x.moveId,10001);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),3000);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,4000);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].effects['裂岩回末MISS吸取'].end,3);const hit=make(x,{hp:1000});timer(hit,1,'攻击必中');turn(hit,x.moveId,10001);assert.equal(sum(hit,'percent'),0);assert.ok(hit.fighters[0].hp<1000);const immune=make(x,{hp:1000});timer(immune,1,'攻击必失');timer(immune,1,'固定百分比免疫');turn(immune,x.moveId,10001);assert.equal(sum(immune,'percent'),0);assert.equal(immune.fighters[0].hp,4000);const ban=make(x,{hp:1000});timer(ban,1,'攻击必失');timer(ban,0,'技能禁疗');turn(ban,x.moveId,10001);assert.equal(ban.fighters[0].hp,1000);assert.equal(sum(ban,'percent'),3000);})
